title: Re-Billed Days and Days Before the Span on Facility Lines, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
For a facility claim line posted against a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or an Inpatient Mental Health Authorization under **Referrals and Authorizations**, the counting window of the line depends on what is already posted to the authorization.

## Rule

The days already posted are counted from the first day of the validity span: they cover the span's first day onward, so the last day already posted is the span's first day plus the days already posted (the total of the authorization's use entries), less one day.

1. **Re-billed days.** Where the line's first covered day falls on or after the first day of the validity span, and the days already posted, counted from the span's first day, reach that covered day or beyond (the facility re-billed days an earlier line already covered), the counting starts on the day after the last day already posted, and the re-billed days are dropped.
2. **Days before the span.** Where the line's first covered day falls before the first day of the span, the counting starts on the span's first day, and the days before it are dropped.
3. **Otherwise** the counting starts on the line's first covered day, and no day is dropped on this ground.

The days dropped are never more than the line's covered days. The day on which the counting starts is the first day the posting counts.

## Judgement table

| Line's first covered day | Last day already posted | Counting starts | Days dropped |
|---|---|---|---|
| on or after the span's first day | on or after the line's first covered day | the day after the last day already posted | from the line's first covered day through the last day already posted |
| on or after the span's first day | before the line's first covered day, or nothing posted | the line's first covered day | none |
| before the span's first day | any | the span's first day | the line days before the span's first day |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

Span first day 1 May; 10 days already posted, so the last day already posted is 10 May.

| Line's first covered day | Reached | Counting starts | Dropped |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 May | yes | 11 May | 3 days (8, 9 and 10 May) |
| 10 May | yes, exactly | 11 May | 1 day (10 May) |
| 11 May | no | 11 May | none |
| 28 April, 6 covered days | first covered day before the span | 1 May | 3 days (28, 29 and 30 April) |
